onboarding.title: You are anonymous here
onboarding.explainer: Khabardar never asks for your name, phone number, or email. A random identity key is created on this device and never leaves it. Reports are anchored to a public blockchain as anonymous fingerprints — the content itself stays encrypted.

home.title: Reports
home.empty: No reports yet. Anything you compose stays encrypted on this device until you submit it.

compose.title: New report
compose.bodyPlaceholder: Describe the incident. Do not include your own name or details that identify you.
compose.locationPlaceholder: e.g. tsj9 — a 4-character geohash, city level only
compose.locationHelp: Only a coarse area code is recorded — never your precise location.
compose.evidenceNote: Metadata (EXIF, GPS, device info) is stripped and the file is encrypted before it is stored.

review.title: Review & submit
review.warning: Re-read your report. Remove anything that could identify you: names of colleagues only you work with, dates only you know, document numbers assigned to you.
review.hashNote: Only an encrypted fingerprint (hash) of this report goes on the blockchain. The report text and evidence never leave this device unencrypted.
review.gasNote: Submission is free — gas is sponsored. You do not need any cryptocurrency.

status.title: Report status
status.draft: Draft — stored encrypted on this device

settings.title: Settings
settings.panicExplainer: Immediately and permanently erases all drafts, evidence files, and your identity key from this device. On-chain fingerprints cannot be deleted, but nothing links them to this device once local data is gone.
settings.panicConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. All drafts, evidence, and your identity will be destroyed.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.stub: Moderation & verification workflow (v0 stub). Moderators will review anchored reports, cross-check evidence, and mark them credible — raising the reporter's karma on-chain. Planned: karma-weighted community juries instead of a single moderator.

tips.title: Tip channel
tips.stub: End-to-end encrypted tip channel to journalists and NGOs (v0 stub). Planned: recipients publish a public key; tips are sealed to that key on-device, relayed over an anonymising transport (Tor / mixnet), and readable only by the recipient.
